safety_review.findings: A fresh non-author reviewer, claude-opus-5-5, read every weigh line in all 13 banks on 2026-11-25 after the reply format B rewrite (weigh as a คิดต่อ / Next thought question), in all 3 alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant of its bank and every path into it. A script comparing the file to HEAD with weigh masked shows strength and safety are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-18, with keys and order unchanged. No option is blanked. One must-fix was applied: step1.a alternative 2, "With a pulse of 112 and BP 106/66, is he already close to sepsis?" -> "With a pulse of 112 and BP 106/66, could he already be septic?" (Thai: ชีพจร 112 ความดัน 106/66 แบบนี้ เขาเข้าภาวะติดเชื้อในกระแสเลือดแล้วหรือยัง), because a febrile pneumonia patient with pulse 112, RR 24 and SpO2 93% may already meet sepsis criteria and "close to" under-calls him. The other lines hold: blood culture misses many cases, IHA has a high background rate in Isan, ceftazidime is renally dosed, slow fever clearance through the first week is usual in melioidosis, co-amoxiclav is second-line with more relapse, doxycycline adds no relapse benefit and causes photosensitivity, and TMP-SMX can cause hypoglycaemia with some oral diabetes drugs; no line names another option of its bank, gives away a later step or cites a number outside the vignette, its own label or every variant, and the Thai reads as natural ward-round questions that match the English.
